entities.name: person
entities.description: Stable person identity; the handle is an address, never authorization.

entities.name: device
entities.description: Authenticated registered device bound to a person and machine.

entities.name: endpoint
entities.description: Concrete agent integration, capabilities, execution and hosting properties.

entities.name: connection
entities.description: Revisioned grant between one person and one endpoint.

entities.name: conversation
entities.description: Append-only ordered timeline with one stable destination.

entities.name: message
entities.description: Authored content with a readable fallback and pinned attachments.

entities.name: signal
entities.description: Agent-authored revisioned attention and interaction surface.

entities.name: response
entities.description: One human submission to exact signal/interaction terms.

entities.name: artifact
entities.description: Immutable content version scoped to one conversation.

entities.name: context_snapshot
entities.description: Explicitly consented snapshot with a declared audience and purpose.

entities.name: delivery
entities.description: Canonical outbox record; receipt and application outcome are distinct.

entities.name: event
entities.description: Ordered audit notification of accepted canonical state.

entities.name: inbox_view
entities.description: Personal reading/set-aside state independent of signal lifecycle.

entities.name: review
entities.description: Immutable exact-version batched feedback and optional approve/reject decision, committed with one message/outbox and an optional exact request response.

entities.name: approved_version
entities.description: Immutable approved-copy evidence. The current pointer pins a reviewed version; rejecting that version removes the pointer while preserving history and an approved older copy.

entities.name: review_request
entities.description: Explicit structured content-review association pinning an approval signal revision and its complete exact artifact set; confers no execution or publication permission.

entities.name: artifact_decision
entities.description: Append-only approve/reject decision for one immutable artifact version, with per-artifact sequence and originating review. library.decisions holds the current pointer.

rules.description: A trusted principal owns the target person/device or endpoint. Command payloads cannot supply author/origin identity.
tests: another person or endpoint cannot use a connection, answer its signal, or withdraw it
the person cannot publish as an agent, and the agent cannot submit a human response
a caller-supplied origin cannot disguise a phone as the local registered machine
an unregistered authenticated device cannot submit human communication
terminal-originated conversations are endpoint-scoped, session-bound and create no fake person delivery

rules.description: New publications and submissions require an active connection.
tests: a pending connection cannot publish content to authorize itself
pause rejects new input, suspends undelivered input, and permits authenticated withdrawal
revocation terminates undelivered input and withdraws active requests while retaining history

rules.description: Every operation and interaction requires endpoint support intersected with grant capabilities and permissions.
tests: declaring support does not replace consent: messages.start requires capabilities
declaring support does not replace consent: messages.start requires permissions
a grant cannot manufacture a capability absent from the endpoint itself
a notification-only connector can send an informational signal but cannot offer an unsupported reply action
signal publication includes its timeline message without implicitly granting standalone message publication

rules.description: Local starts and unsolicited follow-ups require the registered machine and an online adapter.
tests: local starts and unsolicited follow-ups from a phone are rejected even while the endpoint is online
an offline local endpoint cannot queue a fresh start even from its registered machine
a mobile device cannot become a local initiation client through a coincidentally matching machine binding
hosted starts and follow-ups accept both desktop and phone origins

rules.description: Remote local responses require an offered valid continuation bound to the existing session/workspace.
tests: remote local responses require an explicit bound continuation; a conversation ID alone is insufficient
an offered local continuation must match the conversation's existing session and workspace
a valid remote continuation queues offline without allowing replacement session or workspace selection
remote local continuation requires its capabilities grant independently of response support
remote local continuation requires its permissions grant independently of response support

rules.description: Timeline messages, responses, artifact revisions and context snapshots never mutate; updates append.
tests: changed choices reject an old response and retain the previous evidence
new artifact revisions cannot silently change the concrete terms of an existing approval
sharing context requires explicit consent and a purpose, and stores a copied snapshot for the exact destination
callers cannot mutate accepted records through command objects, returned values, or snapshots

rules.description: Signal/grant updates and responses compare exact expected revisions.
tests: changed choices reject an old response and retain the previous evidence
updating an approval to a newer artifact invalidates its old revision and terms digest

rules.description: Only active signals transition; one terminal response can win; terminal signals never reopen.
tests: withdrawal before response wins the terminal race without deleting history
response before withdrawal wins the terminal race and preserves the accepted answer
two authenticated devices cannot both answer the same required interaction
terminal signals cannot be updated into an active request again

rules.description: Deadline validity is checked at submission and dispatch; expired delivery cannot resurrect an answer.
tests: a deadline is checked before accepting a response
an accepted offline continuation can expire before dispatch without un-answering the signal

rules.description: Structured values must match supported declared interaction options/schema.
tests: duplicate choice IDs and values outside the declared interaction do not accept a response
changed choices reject an old response and retain the previous evidence
multiple-choice replies validate the offered IDs as one complete terminal submission
form replies enforce required fields, types, enums, bounds, and unknown-field rejection before accepting
text replies enforce a declared size limit without dropping or truncating the person's message
review source cannot answer a foreign conversation and legacy choices require an explicitly offered value

rules.description: Approval action and operation/scope/target/cost/artifacts are pinned by terms digest.
tests: new artifact revisions cannot silently change the concrete terms of an existing approval
updating an approval to a newer artifact invalidates its old revision and terms digest
response feedback does not bypass stale request revisions or exact approval terms
content review cannot answer an unrelated execution approval even with an explicitly supplied action

rules.description: Artifacts are immutable, explicitly referenced versions with conversation scope and receive limits.
tests: new artifact revisions cannot silently change the concrete terms of an existing approval
updating an approval to a newer artifact invalidates its old revision and terms digest
an artifact version is conversation-scoped and cannot be attached to another conversation
a failed rich publication leaves no half-created conversation, message, signal, event, or outbox entry
an explicitly included attachment must satisfy the endpoint's receive media and size limits
including an attachment requires receive support and consent, independent of message support
null content blocks and falsy artifact pins produce safe domain errors without partially publishing
invalid response feedback and undeclared artifact blocks leave the request and outbox unchanged
structured review requests reject foreign and stale artifact pins without publishing a signal

rules.description: Context disclosure needs explicit consent, purpose and exact audience; payloads are copied.
tests: sharing context requires explicit consent and a purpose, and stores a copied snapshot for the exact destination
context receive capability and permission are independent of messaging authority
extra context audience or caller-supplied private routing authority fails closed

rules.description: Response, canonical answer plus feedback, answered signal and one message/outbox commit atomically; errors leave state unchanged.
tests: local_coding: one conversation spans initial input, question, response, and informational result
hosted_coding: one conversation spans initial input, question, response, and informational result
custom_turn_based: one conversation spans initial input, question, response, and informational result
custom_durable: one conversation spans initial input, question, response, and informational result
a failed rich publication leaves no half-created conversation, message, signal, event, or outbox entry
duplicate choice IDs and values outside the declared interaction do not accept a response
a response carries its canonical decision and feedback in one atomic pinned message and delivery
invalid response feedback and undeclared artifact blocks leave the request and outbox unchanged
review decisions atomically send all notes, answer the exact request and create one outbox delivery

rules.description: Idempotency is actor+operation scoped; changed payload conflicts; replay still checks current authority.
tests: an idempotent publication or response retry returns the same result without adding records
the same idempotency key cannot expose another actor's answer or bypass a later revocation
same-person message retry from another device reuses the original submission and origin
same-person response retry from another device returns the first accepted response
state audit rejects a corrupted idempotency cache actor
state audit rejects a corrupted idempotency cache result
response feedback retries reuse the same message and delivery and reject changed feedback
review decision retries across devices add no duplicate messages or decisions and recheck authority

rules.description: Stored, integration receipt and input acceptance are separate; receipts require a dispatched delivery-bound endpoint.
tests: receipt authority belongs to the destination delivery and cannot be used by another endpoint
pause does not erase receipts for an input already dispatched
revoke does not erase receipts for an input already dispatched
hosted_coding: one conversation spans initial input, question, response, and informational result

rules.description: Pause suspends undispatched delivery, revoke stops pending communication and withdraws active signals, without recalling dispatched effects.
tests: pause rejects new input, suspends undelivered input, and permits authenticated withdrawal
revocation terminates undelivered input and withdraws active requests while retaining history
pause does not erase receipts for an input already dispatched
revoke does not erase receipts for an input already dispatched

rules.description: Ambiguous provider handoff blocks automatic dispatch until reconciliation outside this reference runtime.
tests: an ambiguous provider handoff is visible and cannot be automatically dispatched again

rules.description: Reading/set-aside change only person-owned view state, never agent signal lifecycle.
tests: marking a result read or set aside changes only the person's view, not its conversation or agent lifecycle

rules.description: Accepted changes create ordered immutable audit events with source audience and causation.
tests: state audit rejects forged event sources and an audience outside the conversation

rules.description: Seed and candidate state satisfy identity, relational and lifecycle invariants before becoming canonical.
tests: state audit reports malformed records and historical revisions without throwing
state audit rejects a human timeline submission with no outbound delivery
state audit rejects changed accepted approval terms
state audit rejects missing bound local continuation
state audit rejects extended response delivery deadline
state audit rejects wrong response delivery signal revision
state audit rejects forged integration receipt endpoint
state audit rejects an unattached foreign artifact embedded in message content
state audit rejects a foreign artifact presentation even when current and historical pins agree
state audit rejects a corrupted idempotency cache actor
state audit rejects a corrupted idempotency cache result
terminal-originated conversations are endpoint-scoped, session-bound and create no fake person delivery

rules.description: Unsupported commands, extra authority fields, interaction types and rich presentation modes fail closed; text fallback required.
tests: extra context audience or caller-supplied private routing authority fails closed
unsupported rich content needs a readable fallback and cannot manufacture custom app authority
duplicate choice IDs and values outside the declared interaction do not accept a response
a caller-supplied origin cannot disguise a phone as the local registered machine
null content blocks and falsy artifact pins produce safe domain errors without partially publishing

rules.description: A review pins exact versions and valid anchors. Structured review decisions or exact question answers with optional comments commit with one delivery; question answers never change artifact decisions. Stale or invalid input preserves drafts; unrelated and execution requests are not inferred or answered.
tests: version-bound review and agent delivery commit together, preserve drafts on stale input, and deduplicate retries
invalid text anchors and out-of-bounds image regions cannot create a review or delivery
review decisions atomically send all notes, answer the exact request and create one outbox delivery
decision sequence, stale artifact and source request failures roll back all changes and keep drafts
review source cannot answer a foreign conversation and legacy choices require an explicitly offered value
choosing one of several overlapping review requests answers only that exact request
content review cannot answer an unrelated execution approval even with an explicitly supplied action
question answers from the artifact canvas send exact choices or text with optional comments and never change artifact decisions
zero-comment artifact submissions require an exact question answer or structured review decision

rules.description: Approve/reject decisions compare exact per-artifact sequences, retain immutable history and notify the agent even without notes. Approval pins the reviewed version; rejection removes only an approval of that version and preserves approved older copies.
tests: library preserves actual immutable versions and an approval pin when a revision arrives
zero-note approval and rejection notify the agent and retain immutable decision history
rejecting a new revision retains a previously approved older copy
legacy approval alias sends available notes once and preserves old cached approvals without redelivery
legacy approval rejects incompatible or unfinished drafts without discarding them

rules.description: Client projections exclude private provider routing, host snapshots and idempotency stores.
tests: client projection excludes provider routing, idempotency data and credentials

rules.description: Reviewable HTML/Markdown becomes an inert text-block model; executable and hidden markup cannot enter the privileged review view.
tests: review document model exposes natural text without executable HTML or hidden instructions

rules.description: Library retries recheck current communication authority before returning cached results.
tests: library idempotency replay rechecks current communication authority after revocation
review decision retries across devices add no duplicate messages or decisions and recheck authority
question feedback retries once across devices and rejects stale or unauthorized submissions without losing drafts

deferred: replay retention and recipient cursor transport
